claims.claim: You can ask for a needs assessment by phone.
claims.quote: Contact social services at your local council and ask for a needs assessment. You can call them or do it online.
claims.note: The NHS page says you can call your council's social services to ask for a needs assessment.

claims.claim: You can ask for a needs assessment in person.
claims.note: The text says the assessment itself can happen face-to-face, but that is how it is delivered; no source says you can ask for one in person.
